title: Words to read and colour: Sukoon
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 5 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 5. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Sukoon). Then trace and copy.

panels.title: The quiet circle
points: Sukoon is a small circle on top: ـْ
The letter has no vowel of its own
We join it to the letter before: qul, not qu-la

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read six words with sukoon and draw a circle round each sukoon. The teacher listens to today's group.
questions.a: Six words read: for example قُلْ، لَمْ، مِنْ، هَلْ.

questions.q: Extend: find the sukoon in «وَٱنْحَرْ» (108:2). How many are there?
questions.a: Two: on نْ and on رْ.
A) qul. The laam has a sukoon: it is quiet, so we close on it: qul.

questions.q: Think again: Some letters have a little circle on top. What do you think that circle tells us to do?
questions.a: It tells us the letter is quiet: it has no vowel, so we stop on it and join it to the letter before.
